detail.longDescription: I find Hacker News a little difficult to read on mobile. Most other frontends compromise too much on information density and the minimal feel of the site. So, I made a design heavily inspired by Lobste.rs< https://lobste.rs >, which felt like a better compromise. As a bonus, the site is written using View< https://github.com/git-aarvin/view >, my own simple React alternative.
